text:
marie: Quick sync — finalizing Wed release train for 09:00 PT. Need owners for three lanes (infra, api, frontend), smoke owners, and explicit rollback commands/paths. Reply with: lane + smoke owner + rollback status/path.

sam: I got infra. Smoke owner: me. Rollback ready: yes, tested yesterday.

jess: I can take frontend. Tyler, can you own frontend smoke with me?

tyler: Yep, I’ll run frontend smoke. Note: frontend smoke needs CDN invalidation warmed before canary. Sam, can infra ensure the invalidation token is available?

sam: Yup, I’ll warm the token 10m before deploy.

ravi: I’ll take api lane. Smoke owner: me. Rollback: need one quick review on the DB migration revert plan — tagging @lena for a thumbs-up.

lena: eng-db here — I’ll review and sign off by EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Release train scheduled for 2024-06-18 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT). Canary windows: 15m total; rolling policy 10% -> 50% -> 100%.

marie: Thanks. Can everyone paste the rollback command or path so oncall can trigger it fast if needed?

sam: infra rollback: `/ops/rollback/infra_rollback.sh --to-tag v2024.06.17` — tested in staging.

ravi: api rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=3`. Migration revert SQL at `s3://redwood/migrations/revert_api_20240617.sql`.

tyler: frontend rollback: `s3 sync s3://redwood/frontend/v2024.06.15 /var/www && systemctl restart nginx` — validated in staging.

jess: Frontend smoke checklist (Tyler and I will run):
```
- load homepage
- login flow
- create item + validation
- embed rendering
- visual sanity on mobile
```

marie: Perfect. Proposed smoke run RSVP times (local to deploy): sam (infra) 09:05, ravi (api) 09:06, tyler/jess (frontend) 09:07. If you need to swap, flag here now.

sam: :thumbsup: I’ll be on pager and will warm CDN token at 08:50 PT. No force flags during canary.

tyler: Noted. I’ll post smoke result summary here (pass/fail + any errors).

jess: If we hit a canary failure, we rollback and ping #incidents. Keep canary timeout at 2m per step.

lena: Revert SQL looked fine; left a tiny comment which I’ll update.

marie: Thanks everyone — will consolidate and update the release doc. If anyone hasn’t pasted their rollback path, add it now.
